overloads.semanticRole: The QR RUN command executes the report area whose reference was passed as parameter with the Quick Report current settings, including the output type.

constraints: When area designates an offscreen area, the table to use must first be set with QR SET REPORT TABLE.
On 4D Server (e.g. in a stored procedure), call QR SET DESTINATION with the "*" specifics parameter first so no dialog box appears on the server machine.
Printer problems (out of paper, disconnected, etc.) do not generate an error message.
